description: Turn requirement prose into checkable structure without writing the KB. Use it for one requirement's prose; to plan a whole change request use kb_compile_intent. mode:analyze returns the semantic advisor receipt: the clause ledger, what is grounded, what is ambiguous and suggested modeling (pass clauses for compound prose and optional typed kibi.logic.v1 interpretations). mode:requirement converts one claim (subjectKey, propertyKey, operator, value, or typed logic) into a strict-lane write set and applyPlan. mode:predicates ranks ontology predicate schemas and returns an applicable predicate-fact plan only for reviewed bindings, otherwise an ontology-gap observation. With requirementId, mode:predicates also returns a hash-bound plan (fact write plus requires_predicate link) for kb_apply_plan, whose contradictionAnalysis is the what-if over the current KB; other returned plans apply with kb_upsert, and kb_upsert dryRun with plannedFacts previews a requirement before its facts exist.

argumentBindings.description: Optional exact predicate argument values keyed by argument name; required when binding_status is incomplete.

claimKey.description: Optional advisor-issued claim key for the exact proposition represented by logic.

claimText.description: Optional exact proposition text represented by logic; defaults to text.

clauses.description: Optional complete list of atomic clauses; each must be a verbatim fragment of text.

confidence.description: Confidence of the extracted claim: >= 0.70 yields strict-lane output, lower yields observation-only output.

existingLogicClaims.description: Existing requirement logic_claims values; the update merges the new claim key into them.

id.description: Optional requirement ID used for deterministic draft relationship guidance.

includeExistingSchemas.description: Whether to include the KB's predicate_schema facts beside the built-in predicate catalog. Default: true.

interpretations.description: Optional typed kibi.logic.v1 interpretations from the host model; raw Prolog is not accepted.

logic.description: Optional typed kibi.logic.v1 IR. Kibi validates and canonicalizes it into a rule fact; raw Prolog is rejected.

maxCandidates.description: Maximum ranked predicate candidates to return. Default: 5.

minScore.description: Minimum candidate score. Higher values make ontology-gap fallback more likely. Default: 0.35.

mode.description: analyze (advisor receipt), requirement (strict claim write set) or predicates (ontology predicate plan).

operator.description: Optional claim operator, e.g. eq, gt, lt; sets take eq, includes, subset_of or excludes; matches takes a regex.

polarityHint.description: Optional reviewed polarity override when surface negation does not mean predicate denial.

propertyKey.description: Optional extracted semantic claim propertyKey. Example: 'Retention Years'.

provenance.description: Optional extracted text reference; falls back to source. Example: '.kb/requirements/customer-retention.md#L1'.

requirementId.description: Optional requirement ID the strict write set updates instead of minting a REQ-AUTO id.

schemaId.description: Optional exact reviewed predicate schema ID to use instead of rank order; fails closed if unavailable.

source.description: Optional primary source path used for stable IDs and text refs.

sourceFiles.description: Optional related source files. The first value is used as the source fallback when source is omitted.

status.description: Optional requirement status for draft suggestions.

subjectHint.description: Optional canonical subject key to use as the first predicate argument. Example: 'editor.annotation'.

subjectKey.description: Optional extracted semantic claim subjectKey. Example: 'Customer.Data'.

text.description: Required prose requirement text to model. Example: 'Customer data must be retained for 7 years.'

title.description: Optional requirement title for draft apply plans.

type.description: Entity type context for analysis; only requirements receive deterministic modeling suggestions.

value.description: Optional claim value: string, number, boolean, or a list of strings for a set claim.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional absolute path of the workspace this call is about, such as your git worktree, when it is not the server's.

name: kb_model

bindingHints.description: On provide_argument_bindings: one entry per unbound argument of the recommended candidate with its type, declared constants (allowedValues) when the vocabulary is closed, schema example values and the reason the current value was not accepted. Empty otherwise.

decisionConflicts.description: When no hash-bound plan ran the contradiction analysis: stored decision facts of current requirements that agree with the complete candidate on its key arguments and decide the opposite (requirementId, factId, effect, proposedEffect, canonicalKey). A warning repeats each one.

existingGrounding.description: The grounding links requirementId already has for this claim: matched by claim_key (the same proposition text) or, for a predicate fact, by the recommended candidate's canonical_key (the same predicate tuple in other words; matchedBy says which).

anyOf.description: With requirementId and a complete candidate: the hash-bound kibi.compile-plan.v1 that writes the predicate fact and links requires_predicate in one kb_apply_plan call (approvedPlanHash = plan.planHash). Its contradictionAnalysis is the what-if over the current KB plus the plan; a conflict leaves the plan blocked. Null when no plan applies.
